# GROWW Education

> A Wisconsin-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to grassroots organizing, community leadership development, and civic engagement in Western Wisconsin.

GROWW Education provides training programs and leadership development for community organizers and grassroots activists. The organization works closely with GROWW, a 501(c)(4) sister organization, to build community power and strengthen democratic participation across Western Wisconsin.

## Key Topics

- community organizing
- grassroots leadership
